extraction_status.description: Explicit extraction state only; blank means not classified. No status inferred from missing measurements.

specimen_type.description: Sample specimen; blood pellet includes approved retrospective Sang/celDNA mapping

timepoint.description: Cohort-specific visit label; no calendar-time inference

day.description: Recorded day; negative pretreatment days are permitted; no calendar derivation

extraction_input_volume_ml.description: Available specimen volume: plasma after centrifugation, CSF available volume. Independent of extraction status. Legacy header retained; For extracted samples the entire recorded available volume was used.

dna_ng_per_ml_plasma.description: Total DNA mass divided by recorded available plasma volume; for extracted samples the entire recorded available volume was used

cfdna_ng_per_ml_plasma.description: cfDNA mass divided by recorded available plasma volume; for extracted samples the entire recorded available volume was used

blood_volume_ml.description: Recorded whole-blood volume; no additional interpretation

tube.description: Tube label; no new category harmonization

sampling_plan.description: Meaning remains to be confirmed; whitespace checks only

lineage.description: Whitespace checks only; category interpretation not assessed

gene_fusion.description: Whitespace checks only; clinical interpretation not assessed

cns_status.description: Whitespace checks only; clinical interpretation not assessed

extraction_state_conflict: Resolve which entry is wrong; preserve existing numbers until reviewed
workflow_annotation: Workflow note stored in a date or measurement field
Keep the workflow information in a status or notes field and review the unavailable measurement
aliquot_annotation: Aliquot count supplied instead of volume
Determine volume per aliquot before recording mL; do not infer it from the count
unit_annotation: Verify the unit and enter a numeric value in the column unit; preserve the original in provenance
file_unreadable: Open and repair or re-export the source workbook
sheet_missing: Restore the selected sheet or correct the source selection
header_duplicate: Choose one authoritative column; retain source evidence
unheaded_data: Identify the column meaning and add a header
whitespace: Review and trim or replace the extra whitespace
category: Check against the approved labels; do not infer a replacement
number_text: Interpret the annotation before entering an exact measurement
numeric_text: Review its numeric interpretation; Excel ISNUMBER does not accept text
number_invalid: Invalid numeric value or physical range
Review the measurement and its unit or fraction scale
date_text: Confirm the date and store a real Excel date
excel_error: Review the formula and its inputs, then recalculate in Excel
self_reference: Remove the circular reference using the intended inputs
identifier_reference: Retrieve the measurement or correct its intended operands
cross_row_reference: Formula references another row or sheet
Confirm the intended source row even when current dates or values match
formula_unassessed: Formula dependencies cannot be fully checked
Review unsupported or indirect references in Excel
cache_missing: Recalculate and save in Excel; preserve intentionally empty results
denominator: Plasma normalization has a nonpositive volume
Review extraction input volume before normalizing
missing_operands: Check whether the result was measured independently or lacks source inputs
false_zero: Formula produces zero with missing inputs
Use the guarded formula; preserve genuine measured zeros
missing_result: Numeric operands exist without a numeric result
Check the calculation, saved result and Excel numeric cell types
